paths.title: Python Fundamentals
paths.description: Master the core programming concepts of the Python language, including primitive types, basic data structures, logical operations, and software modularity.
paths.outcome: Able to write, read, and understand basic modular Python programs, design simple functions, and handle standard runtime errors.

modules.title: Python Core and Primitive Types
modules.description: Learn the baseline building blocks of Python: how variables hold data, and how primitive data types model real-world concepts.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.description: Discover how Python names values and stores different representations of data.

lessons.title: Strings and Booleans
lessons.description: Work with text data and basic logical flags.

checkpoint.title: Module 1 Review: Variable Binding & Types
checkpoint.description: A review challenge testing your knowledge of storage, strings, and true/false flags.

completionRequirements.description: Pass the Python Core & Types quiz on variables, string operations, and booleans with 100% correct answers.

modules.title: Structured Collections
modules.description: Organize data using list collections, key-value mappings, immutable sequences, and sequence positions.

lessons.title: Lists and Indexing
lessons.description: Learn about ordered mutable sequences and how to target items by their positional indexes.

lessons.title: Dictionaries and Tuples
lessons.description: Deepen your collection knowledge with key-value pairs and immutable, read-only structures.

checkpoint.title: Module 2 Review: Data Collections
checkpoint.description: Evaluate your understanding of structural mutability, indexing offsets, and hash lookups.

completionRequirements.description: Complete the data collections assessment with a score of 80% or higher.

modules.title: Flow Control and Executable Logic
modules.description: Unleash program responsiveness through functional components, arguments, conditionals, and loops.

lessons.title: Functions, Parameters, and Return Values
lessons.description: Package reusable procedures that accept inputs and hand back processed outcomes.

lessons.title: Conditionals and Loops
lessons.description: Add branching paths and cyclic loops to repeat work efficiently.

checkpoint.title: Module 3 Review: Operational Flow Control
checkpoint.description: A quiz testing logic pathways, conditional expressions, and finite versus infinite loops.

completionRequirements.description: Pass the interactive operational flow control test with 90% or higher.

modules.title: Object Modularity and Robust Structure
modules.description: Master clean design using object orientation, imported codebases, robust fail-safes, and clean documentation.

lessons.title: Classes, Objects, and Imports
lessons.description: Model structured data types with object classes and tap into outer code modules.

lessons.title: Error Handling and Comments
lessons.description: Write fail-proof execution flows and record clear, human-readable commentary.

finalCheckpoint.title: Python Foundations Graduation
finalCheckpoint.description: Bring all fundamentals together by demonstrating full conceptual grasp of Python syntax, logic, collections, and errors.

completionRequirements.description: Complete the comprehensive Python cumulative final exam with at least an 85% score.

paths.title: Software Testing Foundations
paths.description: Gain a solid grasp of software testing methodology, lifecycle phases, verification levels, defect triage, and Agile collaboration.
paths.outcome: Understand how software quality assurance fits into modern product development, design useful test scenarios, and write structured bug reports.

modules.title: Lifecycle, Scope, and Design
modules.description: Establish the foundational phases of software creation, analyzing requirements, and organizing structured test rules.

lessons.title: The Lifecycle and Requirements
lessons.description: Learn the stages of software creation and how to translate user expectations into testable rules.

lessons.title: Test Planning and Cases
lessons.description: Formulate a systematic strategy and detailed step-by-step verification flows.

checkpoint.title: Module 1 Review: QA Planning and Analysis
checkpoint.description: Demonstrate understanding of requirement parsing and basic test planning structure.

completionRequirements.description: Complete a mock review of a test plan document against user requirements.

modules.title: Testing Levels and Verification Scope
modules.description: Study the multi-tiered pyramid of testing, from early functional units up to actual end-user expectations.

lessons.title: Unit, Integration, and Regression Verification
lessons.description: Understand how code isolations and system compositions are validated, and how to verify old features don't break.

lessons.title: Smoke, Acceptance, and Fringe Conditions
lessons.description: Conduct rapid sanity tests, coordinate final user signs-offs, and target tricky off-limit variables.

checkpoint.title: Module 2 Review: Levels & Scope
checkpoint.description: A quiz measuring understanding of unit tests versus UAT, regression impacts, and edge cases.

completionRequirements.description: Score 85% or higher on the Testing Levels Quiz.

modules.title: Defect Management and Triage
modules.description: Master how to spot deviations from expected results, triage their severity, and write reproducible steps.

lessons.title: Bugs and Replication Paths
lessons.description: Understand what constitutes a defect and how to construct unambiguous paths to expose them.

lessons.title: Triage and Priority Assessment
lessons.description: Learn to separate technical functional severity from business priority and timelines.

checkpoint.title: Module 3 Review: Bug Logging and Priority Triaging
checkpoint.description: Simulated exercise logging a defect and assigning realistic severity/priority ratings.

completionRequirements.description: Assess a mock bug report and verify it contains clear, repeatable reproduction steps.

modules.title: Agile Delivery and Collaboration
modules.description: Integrate software testing into standard collaborative Agile teams, sprint cycles, and standup channels.

lessons.title: Sprints and Backlog Management
lessons.description: Discover how quality goals fit into fixed-duration delivery sprints and product backlogs.

lessons.title: Daily Alignment and Retrospectives
lessons.description: Participate in quick daily status alignments and post-sprint reflection loops.

finalCheckpoint.title: Quality Assurance Specialist Examination
finalCheckpoint.description: A final evaluation testing your core QA knowledge from specifications analysis through to agile team shipping.

completionRequirements.description: Achieve a minimum score of 90% on the Software Testing cumulative final examination.

paths.title: Introduction to Philosophy
paths.description: Explore the history of classical thought, ancient moral pathways, the foundational structure of arguments, and critical thinking fallacies.
paths.outcome: Analyze classical philosophical frameworks, apply stoic concepts of control, and spot logical fallacies in real-world arguments.
prerequisites: Open-mindedness and willingness to challenge preconceptions

modules.title: Classical Foundations and Virtues
modules.description: Step into ancient Athens to explore Plato's idealism, Aristotle's ethical balance, and Socrates' inquiry methods.

lessons.title: Socratic Method, Platonic Forms, and the Cave
lessons.description: Learn to query assumptions using guided questioning, investigate the Theory of Forms, and escape the cognitive cave.

lessons.title: Aristotelian Ethics and the Mean
lessons.description: Study character development, virtue systems, and finding balance in human action.

checkpoint.title: Module 1 Review: The Classical Athenian Legacy
checkpoint.description: Test your mastery of Platonic Forms, Socratic inquiry, and Aristotle's ethics.

completionRequirements.description: Score 85% or higher on the Athenian Foundations quiz.

modules.title: Stoicism and Practical Resilience
modules.description: Examine how Stoicism equips individuals to maintain focus, handle misfortune, and achieve tranquil resilience.

lessons.title: The Dichotomy of Control and Acceptance
lessons.description: Partition inputs into those under your control versus those that are not, and practice mental resilience.

lessons.title: Stoic Meditations on Mortality and Risk
lessons.description: Explore practical exercises like contemplating mortality and pre-visualizing worst-case risks.

checkpoint.title: Module 2 Review: Stoic Praxis
checkpoint.description: An interactive exercise where you apply Stoic principles to modern stressors and challenges.

completionRequirements.description: Complete the 'Modern Stoic Response' reflection journal to identify things within your sphere of control.

modules.title: Critical Logic and Fallacies
modules.description: Acquire the formal tools of deductive arguments, learn structural validity, and dissect common cognitive fallacies.

lessons.title: Argument Syllogisms, Validity, and Soundness
lessons.description: Construct valid logical deductions and separate valid structures from factual truths.

lessons.title: Identifying Logical Fallacies
lessons.description: Learn to detect and avoid ad hominem personal attacks, straw man caricatures, false choices, and slippery slopes.

finalCheckpoint.title: Philosophical Synthesis & Critical Thinking Review
finalCheckpoint.description: Evaluate arguments for sound deductive logic, identify underlying moral theories, and demonstrate practical application of ancient frameworks.

completionRequirements.description: Complete the Introduction to Philosophy Comprehensive Exam with at least an 80% passing grade.
